up: Return the ChEMBL IDs, preferred names, and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested against the target with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL1293258 (human Mothers against decapentaplegic homolog).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293258';
